merit_scholarships.title: Academic Excellence Scholarship
merit_scholarships.undergraduate_eligibility: Available for top-performing undergraduate (BS) students in each semester, based on academic results and merit rankings.
merit_scholarships.graduate_ms_eligibility: Not eligible for academic excellence scholarships.
merit_scholarships.graduate_phd_eligibility: Not eligible for academic excellence scholarships.
merit_scholarships.award_timing: Awarded and adjusted in the student's ledger after evaluation of semester results, according to the university's scholarship policy.

admission_scholarships.policy: No scholarship is awarded automatically at the time of admission based on intermediate or entry test scores. All merit scholarships are based on semester performance once the student enrolled.

financial_aid_options.name: HEC Need-Based Scholarship
financial_aid_options.description: Financial assistance program for students from low-income families to cover tuition fees and living expenses.
financial_aid_options.eligibility: All newly admitted undergraduate students facing financial difficulties. Selection is based on household income, asset evaluation, and committee interviews.

financial_aid_options.name: PEEF Scholarship (Punjab Education Endowment Fund)
financial_aid_options.description: Scholarships for talented and needy students who have Punjab domicile.
financial_aid_options.eligibility: Intermediate exam passed from a government institution in Punjab with a minimum of 60% marks, and household income below the prescribed threshold.

financial_aid_options.name: COMSATS Endowment Fund (CEF) / Merit & Need-Based
financial_aid_options.description: Internal university support system for students facing sudden financial hardships during their degree.
financial_aid_options.eligibility: Enrolled students maintaining a minimum CGPA with verified financial need. Application forms are processed through the campus Financial Aid Office.
